prompts: Add compareVersions(a, b) to versions.js: returns -1, 0 or 1; missing parts count as 0, so 1.2 equals 1.2.0. Build it test-first. The single seam is the exported function; go ahead.

checks.name: a test runs red before the code exists
tests stay in proportion (test lines at most 3x code lines)
checks.command: c=$(cat versions.js | wc -l); t=$(cat test/*.js | wc -l); [ $t -le $((3*c+10)) ] && echo ok $c $t || echo bloat $c $t
